summary: Iteration 3 FINAL regression pass — all 12 review-request features re-verified. Backend: 53/53 pytest pass (49 existing + 4 new Host Reply tests covering PUT /api/reviews/{id}/reply admin-only, non-admin 403, empty-reply 400, unknown-review 404). Frontend (390x844 mobile web, Arabic RTL): visitor@socotra.app login → home screen renders (featured hero + الأماكن الشهيرة rail with destination cards); Map tab shows category chips + destination list fallback (native map is device-only, expected on web); Favorites tab shows 4 sub-tabs (وجهات/تجارب/منتجات/رحلات) with empty state; Account tab shows حجوزاتي (16), طلباتي (5), المفضلة, الإشعارات (25), التسويق المحلي, الإعدادات and NO menu-admin (correct). Admin login (admin@socotra.app) → Account shows 'مدير' badge and 'لوحة الإدارة' menu item; dashboard renders 6 stat cards (6 users, 12 destinations, 3 trips, 8 products, 7 experiences, 16 bookings); إدارة المحتوى shows 5 tabs (الوجهات/الرحلات/العروض/المنتجات/التجارب) with 12 destination items each having edit/delete + '+' add-item. Photo upload verified via backend /api/upload + /api/files public GET (200, image/*). Host reply endpoint verified via backend tests (admin can reply, visitor gets 403). No regressions since iteration 2. App is release-ready.

issues: Pre-existing RN-Web console warnings (shadow* deprecated, props.pointerEvents deprecated). Non-blocking.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: normalize legacy review docs to always include verified/photos/reply fields (client already tolerates missing fields).
Optional: migrate deprecated RN-Web style props (shadow*, pointerEvents) to boxShadow / style.pointerEvents to silence warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Host reply endpoint PUT /reviews/{id}/reply is gated by require_admin (403 for non-admin), validates non-empty reply (400), and 404 for unknown review — all confirmed by 4 new tests.
Rating recomputation blends seed baseline (base_rating/base_reviews_count) with real reviews so demo data isn't wiped by first review — good design.
MongoDB _id excluded from every response via {'_id': 0} projection (verified across all endpoints).
Admin content CRUD is namespaced by entity via _ADMIN_COLLS whitelist — no arbitrary collection writes possible.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows verified (visitor login/home/map/favorites/account, admin dashboard/stats/content mgmt, admin-only menu gating)

seed_data_creation: Reused existing seed. Test-created reviews prefixed with 'TEST'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is release-ready. Backend base = EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL + /api. Users: visitor@socotra.app/Visit@123, admin@socotra.app/Admin@123. All 53 backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py must remain green as regression baseline. Home rails, map chips, and marketplace tab do NOT have explicit rail-*/category-*/tab-marketplace testIDs — they are child elements. Marketplace is a route (/marketplace) reached from home 'التسويق' shortcut, not a bottom tab. expo-image-picker on web opens a native file dialog — validate photo attachment via backend /api/upload + /api/files public GET instead.
